# deepdocs

## Usage

```tsx
import { DeepDocs } from 'deepdocs';

export default function Page() {
  return <DeepDocs entry="./src/index.ts" />;
}
```

```bash
# Generates docs into ./site
deepdocs build --out site
```

## Install

```bash
pnpm add -D deepdocs
```
